name: LinkedIn Ads
description: LinkedIn Marketing and Advertising APIs for campaign management, reporting, audiences and conversions.
auth_notes: Apps are created in the LinkedIn Developer portal with a Client ID; the credential type sent on calls is not stated in the readable sources.
gate_detail: Create an app, add Advertising API and complete the access form; LinkedIn reviews it for Development tier. Private APIs need further approval. Established business and use case required.
api_scope: Advertising API covers Ad Campaigns, Creatives, Ad Analytics, Matched and Predictive Audiences, Event Ads; the program also lists Conversions and Media Planning APIs.
mcp_notes: Sources do not mention an MCP server.
blocker_detail: Advertising API access requires application review, vetting, and further approval for private APIs.

evidence.quote: In the Application Client ID field, enter your API key.
Do you have an established business?
These APIs are private and require additional approval once you’ve been approved for the Advertising API.
To gain access to the Marketing APIs, read more information on our API offering
The platform offers APIs to create LinkedIn marketing campaigns

issues: OAuth flow details are not visible in the sources.
